sources.title: China's AI toy boom puts generative AI in kids' hands ... - Cybernews
sources.snippet: Talking toys have been around forever, but now China's AI toy makers are embedding generative models into plush toys and companion devices. The shift marks a notable moment for the industry, with generative AI becoming embedded in everyday consumer products. Children are among the first to experience it in physical form, raising new safety and privacy concerns.
